CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red) and a separate origin/representation entry (origin) are both explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim tied to the identified content.

C.rationale: Explicitly identifies content referent and an attribute (red) with literal coordinate value.

D.rationale: The report separately lists identified content attributes (red) and an origin/representation status for the same referent.

O.rationale: The origin/represented_time metadata explicitly reports how the content is represented/accessed.
